description_en: Queries mount information of KVCacheInstances in batches
description_zh: 批量查询 KVCacheInstance 挂载信息
kebab_example: aliyun kvcachestore list-kv-cache-store-attach-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --kvcs-ids kvcs-87djda131 --max-results 20 --next-token your-client-token --page-number 6 --page-size 20 --vsc-id vsc-dhag651dsda --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListKVCacheStoreAttachInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID, such as cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of KVCacheStore KvcsIds to query. You can specify up to 100 KvcsIds
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的 KVCacheStore KvcsId 列表，最多 100 个
parameters.name: kvcs_ids

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return per query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
查询时单次的最大条目数。取值范围：1~500

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. If NextToken is specified, the PageSize and PageNumber request parameters become invalid, and the TotalCount value in the response is invalid
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。如果设置了NextToken，则请求参数PageSize和PageNumber将失效，且返回数据中的TotalCount无效
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging queries. Used together with PageSize. If the specified page number exceeds the total number of pages, the last page of data is returned
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。配合PageSize使用，超出总数时会返回最后一页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The VSC ID on the compute side. If specified, mount records are filtered by the specified VSC
parameters.help_zh: 计算侧 VSC ID，传入时按指定 VSC 过滤挂载记录
parameters.name: vsc_id

AttachedAt.description_en: The time of the most recent attach operation in ISO 8601 format. This value is null if the instance is not attached
AttachedAt.description_zh: 最近一次 Attach 时间（ISO 8601 格式），未 Attach 时为 null
AttachedAt.title_zh: 最近一次 Attach 时间（ISO 8601 格式），未 Attach 时为 null

Capacity.description_en: The file system capacity in GiB

MountPointId.description_en: The file system-level mount point ID
MountPointId.description_zh: 文件系统级别挂载点 ID
MountPointId.title_zh: 文件系统级别挂载点 ID

RegionId.description_en: The region where the instance is deployed

Status.description_en:
The attach status. Valid values:
Attaching: The instance is being attached.
Attached: The instance is attached.
Detaching: The instance is being detached.

After detachment is complete, the record is deleted and not returned
Status.description_zh: Attach 状态：Attaching（挂载中）/ Attached（已挂载）/ Detaching（卸载中），卸载完成后记录删除不返回
Status.title_zh: Attach 状态：Attaching（挂载中）/ Attached（已挂载）/ Detaching（卸载中），卸载完成后记录删除不返回

Type.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
kvcs: KVCacheStore (CPFS)

VscId.description_en: The VSC ID on the compute side

ZoneId.description_en: The zone where the instance is deployed

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token. Use this token to query the next batch of data
NextToken.description_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。用于查询下一批数据
NextToken.title_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。用于查询下一批数据。

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. A request ID is returned regardless of whether the call is successful
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。无论调用接口成功与否，我们都会返回请求 ID
RequestId.title_zh: 请求ID。无论调用接口成功与否，我们都会返回请求 ID。

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned for a paging query
TotalCount.description_zh: 分页查询时的结果总条数
TotalCount.title_zh: 分页查询时的结果总条数。
